pageTitle: Petitfee, Super Volume Lip Oil, 0.1 oz (3 g)
h1: Petitfee, Super Volume Lip Oil, 0.1 oz (3 g)

ld.name: Petitfee, Super Volume Lip Oil, 0.1 oz (3 g)
ld.description: Volumizing + Firming + Nourishing A special lip oil that gives the lips natural vitality and elasticity. The natural colors are affected by direct sunlight, and may fade during use, but this is not related to quality.

blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: A special lip oil that gives the lips natural vitality and elasticity.
The natural colors are affected by direct sunlight, and may fade during use, but this is not related to quality.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Apply to lips every so often when dry.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Hydrogenated polyisobutene, simmondsia chinensis (jojoba) seed oil, caprylic/capric triglyceride, ethylene/propylene/styrene copolymer, macadamia ternifolia seed oil, corylus avellana (hazelnut) seed oil, prunus amygdalus dulcis (sweet almond) oil, helianthus annuus (sunflower) seed oil, butylene/ethylene /styrene copolymer, tocopherol, eclipta prostrata extract, sclerocarya birrea seed oil, fragrance/parfum. water, rosa canina fruit oil, opuntia ficus-indica seed oil, melia azadirachta leaf extract, calendula officinalis flower oil, bht, moringa oleifera seed oil, glycerin, 1,2-hexanediol, rose extract, calendula officinalis flower extract, anemarrhena asphodeloides root extract, alpha-isomethyl ionone, citronellol, geraniol, linalool.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Do not apply to skin if you have any scratches, lacerations or skin complications. Stop using if signs of irritation, itchiness or rash appears.
